description: Archives one of your strategies, as Delete does on the website: it turns inactive, stops counting toward the tier limit, and cannot be reactivated here. Use it to retire a strategy; to change one use update_strategy. strategy_id comes from get_my_strategies, which keeps listing the row with active false; repeating the call succeeds, and another account's id reads as not found. A bot already deployed from it keeps running on its own copy. Needs a write-scope key.

strategy_id.description: Id of your strategy to archive, from get_my_strategies.

name: delete_strategy

error.description: Set only on a failed call (isError true): what went wrong.
